name: goal
description: Tracks what the user wants and how they will judge it done, with acceptance criteria and steps, in a panel the user can see. Use it when a request has a completion condition you can check and needs three or more steps. Set the goal before starting, keep exactly one goal per session, and update criteria as evidence appears; only use outcome achieved when every criterion is met. Do not use it for a single trivial step, and do not restate a todo list in it: criteria are the definition of done, steps are the order of the work.

mode.description: set replaces the goal, its criteria and its steps; update changes the existing goal and its items by id.

goal.description: What the user wants, in one line: the panel shows it as the header. Required with mode set.

done_when.description: How the user will judge it done, stated so it can be checked: the panel shows it as the subtitle. Required with mode set.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria: statements that are either met or not. In mode set every item needs a label; in mode update an item with an id changes that criterion, and a label without an id adds one.

id.description: Stable item id from an earlier result. Omit to add a new criterion.

label.description: The criterion or, in update mode, its new text.

note.description: Evidence for the status, such as the command and its result.

steps.description: The order of the work, when it is worth showing. At most one step may be in_progress.

id.description: Stable item id from an earlier result. Omit to add a new step.

detail.description: One line of detail; the panel shows at most 200 characters.

outcome.description: Closes the goal: achieved marks the panel done, abandoned marks it failed. Use achieved only when every criterion is met; use abandoned when the user stops the work.

clear.description: update mode only: remove criteria that are done or skipped.

actions.label: Continue
actions.text: Continue working toward the current goal and report progress against its criteria.

actions.label: Abandon goal
actions.confirm: Abandon this goal? The panel keeps its state; nothing else changes.

actions.label: Explain blocker
actions.text: Explain why "{{item.label}}" is blocked and what you need from me to unblock it.
